# Remote Control Agent v0.1.43 — Windows Session credential-free WSS checkpoints

- Spec [#62](https://github.com/lirtual/github-actions/issues/62): add bounded, credential-free initialization and authenticated WebSocket stage checkpoints to the GitHub-hosted Windows **Session-only** RCA child. An existing Windows private ACL-sealed file in `RUNNER_TEMP/session-rca` records only allowlisted stages; the GitHub Actions bootstrap in [PR #77](https://github.com/lirtual/github-actions/pull/77) reads a single stage name. Raw exception text, GitHub OIDC, private keys, device IDs, URLs and process environments are never logged.
- Source [Agent PR #86](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/86), merged at immutable commit `0ef6fafbc7dee8250acc758ecaefcb799839b765`. Native Linux x64/ARM64 and Windows `main` CI [#41223302184](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41223302184) passed. The separate pinned three-platform candidate CI run and SHA-256 checks must pass before this release pin may be merged.
- Earlier real GitHub-hosted Windows test [#41221541876](https://github.com/lirtual/github-actions/actions/runs/41221541876) proved the registration parent exited successfully and a credential-free child was observed alive, but its device remained Offline. These new checkpoints are **diagnostics, not a confirmed Windows WSS fix**. A short, separately authorized real Session must locate the first failed child stage, then demonstrate authenticated WSS, harmless file/Shell operations, Stop and physical cleanup before Spec #62 is accepted.
- No new Worker, database, long-lived service, authorization bypass or permanent-device upgrade. Workflow remains authoritative for every fresh Session admission. The ordinary SSH/RDP Session stays usable if RCA fails.
- Promotion is gated by a reviewed immutable three-platform pin and the existing GitHub Actions publisher. Production `SESSION_RCA_*` must remain on verified `v0.1.40` until a separately authorized, bounded Windows-only test switches the SHA-pinned values and restores them. No ordinary production Plan or permanent paired device is changed by preparing this Release.
